source_caption_text:
His laugh hasn’t changed one bit 😂😂

Via: @thediaryofaceopodcast 

Druski’s been making people laugh since long before the fame 😂😂

He started posting comedy skits on Instagram in 2017, building a following with his spot-on characters and sketches inspired by everyday situations. The big turning point came in 2020, when Drake invited him to appear in the “Laugh Now Cry Later” video a moment Druski has said helped change the course of his career.

Since then, he’s grown far beyond social media: taking his comedy on tour, launching the Coulda Been Records audition series, and stepping into hosting and acting. Most recently, he hosted the 2026 BET Awards and continues to bring his comedy to new audiences.

And after seeing those old videos, it’s clear the funny was there from the start 😂
